a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two calm rounds before anyone takes. That gives about a 4% chance that either of us survives. I don't think it's workable, so I'm proposing we change it now rather than break it quietly. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random. Afterward I'll operate and give back anything over 4 to help you reach 4 if the storm holds off. Tell me if you see a better option.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. If we both took and I ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back. From now on I'll operate every round to refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
